prompt_strategy.name: strategy
prompt_strategy.prompt:
# What strategy did you use during the game?

- How did you decide on your strategy?
- Did you change your strategy? If so, when? How?

Please use at least 200 characters.
prompt_strategy.value:
We started with describing them by color and I immediately recognized some obvious differences in the hats, arms and shoes. Once we figured out a plan of starting at the top and working downward, it became much simpler. The final task was the most difficult because there was the most variance, so we added a 1-10 scale rating for height, but a bit more time to agree on heights would have been beneficial.

Also note that I didn't use hte Report Bugs button, but there were multiple times throughout the study where I noticed words disappeared from my textbox after I typed (it just did it in this note box at the end lmao - deleted like the last 3 words I typed). I asked my partner, and he said it happened to him as well - so that definitely accounts for some of our mistakes! We shouldve gotten more points if not for bugs lol

prompt_strategy.name: strategy
prompt_strategy.prompt:
# What strategy did you use during the game?

- How did you decide on your strategy?
- Did you change your strategy? If so, when? How?

Please use at least 200 characters.
prompt_strategy.value: We each said what we thought each object looked like, then agreed on what would be easiest for us both to remember/spell. We agreed on who would type and also went over each label again before taking the quiz. We helped each other think of visual cues in order to remember the names of the labels, based on characteristics, "hats," or what certain parts of the object looked like, or perhaps a cartoon character they resembled based on color, shape, or general appearance. We didn't really change our strategy, we tried to keep it simple so we could remember easily and not use words that might be too challenging for us to spell correctly so we didn't accidentally get any wrong because of spelling. We used nouns like object names or character names.
